claims.sort: Single-symbol endpoint supports descending timestamp order.
claims.bounds: Start and end are inclusive; RFC-3339 timestamps are accepted.
claims.limit: Each response page is capped between 1 and 10000 points and may return fewer points while more remain.
claims.adjustment: split adjusts price and volume for stock splits.

implementation_scope: Preserve configured feed and split adjustment; request latest available bars in the retained fixed calendar window.
